messages.en:
{07 14 00}The {ff 00 00 03}Bug-Off{ff 00 00 00} starts today!


{07 16 00}Is it weird for a girl to
chase down bugs, swinging
her net like a maniac?
{07 14 00}Because if it is, then
maybe I don't want to be
normal.{01 00 00 0f 00} {07 06 00}I need that {ff 00 00 07}trophy{ff 00 00 00}!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}{ff 00 00 03}Putukavõistlus{ff 00 00 00} algab täna!


{07 16 00}Kas on veider, kui tüdruk
ajab putukaid taga ja vehib
võrguga nagu hull?
{07 14 00}Sest kui on, siis ehk ei
taha ma olla
normaalne.{01 00 00 0f 00} {07 06 00}Vajan {ff 00 00 07}karikat{ff 00 00 00}!

messages.en:
{07 15 00}I've been pushing myself
extra hard training for
this year's {ff 00 00 03}Bug-Off{ff 00 00 00}!
{07 00 00}And you know what? It looks
like my training is finally
paying off, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 14 00}I can now OFFICIALLY look at
a picture of a beetle
without wanting to puke!
messages.et:
{07 15 00}Ma olen end eriti kõvasti
treeninud selle aasta
{ff 00 00 03}putukavõistluseks{ff 00 00 00}!
{07 00 00}Ja tead mida? Paistab, et
mu treening hakkab lõpuks
vilja kandma, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 14 00}Ma suudan nüüd AMETLIKULT
vaadata põrnika pilti
ilma oksendamissooviga!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}It's about time! I've been
waiting for the {ff 00 00 03}Bug-Off{ff 00 00 00}
for ages, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 15 00}And now, as of today, I can
hold my {ff 00 00 03}net{ff 00 00 00} up high! But
only just for a moment...
{07 0d 00}Then, I'll slam it down with
a mighty FWAP! {07 0b 00}Or{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.should
that be "BLAP!" instead?
messages.et:
{07 14 00}On viimane aeg! Ma olen
{ff 00 00 03}putukavõistlust{ff 00 00 00} oodanud
igaviku, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 15 00}Ja nüüd, alates tänasest,
saan ma hoida oma {ff 00 00 03}võrku{ff 00 00 00}
kõrgel! Aga ainult hetkeks...
{07 0d 00}Siis löön ma selle alla
vägeva VUHH-ga! {07 0b 00}Või{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.peaks
olema hoopis „PLÄRTS!”?

messages.en:
{07 14 00}In case you didn't know,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0a 00} I've got the
record, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 00 00}That's right. I caught
{04 1a 00}
that's {ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00} mm{ff 00 00 00} long!
{07 07 00}It's actually a little bit
frightening to look at!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Juhuks, kui sa ei teadnud,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0a 00} mul on
rekord, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 00 00}Just nii. Ma püüdsin
{04 1a 00},
mis on {ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00} mm{ff 00 00 00} pikk!
{07 07 00}Seda on tegelikult pisut
hirmus vaadata!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Have you heard about the
{0b 02 00}{04 1a 00} I
caught? It was huge!
{07 00 00}It was easily {ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00} mm{ff 00 00 00}
long, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 07 00}Did you see the size of the
{0b 02 00}{04 1a 00} I
caught? {01 00 00 05 00}It was disgusting!
Seriously, it must have
been {ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00} mm {ff 00 00 00}long!

{07 00 00}I hear it's the biggest one
right now. {01 00 00 05 00}{07 16 00}I'd hate to think
that they came any bigger!
messages.et:
{07 07 00}Kas sa nägid, kui suur oli
{0b 02 00}{04 1a 00}, mille
ma püüdsin? {01 00 00 05 00}See oli jäle!
Tõsiselt, see pidi olema
{ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00} mm {ff 00 00 00}pikk!

{07 00 00}Kuulsin, et see on
praegu suurim. {01 00 00 05 00}{07 16 00}Ma ei tahaks
mõelda, et on suuremaid!

messages.en:
{07 0e 00}Have you heard about a
{ff 00 00 07}golden net{ff 00 00 00}? I wonder if it's
hard to use{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 00 00}You'd think it would have
to be heavy, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.{01 01 00}
{07 06 00}I mean, it IS made of gold.
messages.et:
{07 0e 00}Kas sa oled kuulnud
{ff 00 00 07}kuldsest võrgust{ff 00 00 00}? Huvitav,
kas see on raske{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 00 00}Võiks arvata, et see peab
olema raske, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.{01 01 00}
{07 06 00}Ma mõtlen, see ON kullast.

messages.en:
{07 00 00}The key to catching bugs is
not to move around too
much.
You have to sneak up on it
verrry quietly {01 00 00 05 00}{07 14 00}and then
bring down your {ff 00 00 07}net{ff 00 00 00} quickly.
{07 01 00}Which is a little hard to do
with you following me
around, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Putukate püüdmise võti on
mitte liiga palju ringi
liikuda.
Sa pead hiilima väga
vaikselt ligi {01 00 00 05 00}{07 14 00}ja siis
kiiresti {ff 00 00 07}võrgu{ff 00 00 00} alla laskma.
{07 01 00}Mida on natuke raske teha,
kui sa mulle järgned,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Right now, {04 10 00} is in
the lead with the biggest
bug, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 1a 00}And it sounded like it was
crazy big, too!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Praegu juhib {04 10 00}
kõige suurema
putukaga, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 1a 00}Ja kõlas nii, nagu oleks
see hullult suur!

messages.en:
{07 0e 00}I wonder what goes through
a bug's mind{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.

{ff 00 00 04}It's pretty clear that
{04 10 00} isn't afraid of
bugs, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 16 00}I get grossed out just
looking at them. I'm gonna
have to get over that.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
messages.et:
{ff 00 00 04}On päris selge, et
{04 10 00} ei karda
putukaid, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 16 00}Mul hakkab paha juba neid
vaadates. Ma pean sellest
üle saama.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Have you heard? Everyone's
running around, shouting
"{04 10 00} is in the lead!"
{07 06 00}And with a {ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00}-mm{ff 00 00 00}
{0b 02 00}{04 1a 00}! Ew!
That gives me the creeps!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Kas sa oled kuulnud? Kõik
jooksevad ringi ja hüüavad
„{04 10 00} juhib!”
{07 06 00}Ja {ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00}-mm{ff 00 00 00}
{0b 02 00}putukaga nimega {04 1a 00}!
Äh! Mul hakkab kohe paha!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}What do you suppose bugs
are thinking about when
they're twiddling their legs?
Or when they jump up and
fly away without even the
slightest warning?
{07 0e 00}It's one of the great
cosmic mysteries.
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Mida putukad sinu arust
mõtlevad, kui nad oma
jalgu liigutavad?
Või kui nad hüppavad ja
lendavad minema ilma
vähimagi hoiatuseta?
{07 0e 00}See on üks suuri
kosmilisi mõistatusi.

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Someone told me there's a
type of bug you can find
only near a certain flower.
{07 16 00}I just can't remember what
it's called.{01 01 00} {07 08 00}I can't even
remember the flower's name!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Keegi ütles mulle, et on
üks putukaliik, mida leiab
ainult teatud lille juurest.
{07 16 00}Ma lihtsalt ei mäleta,
mis selle nimi on.{01 01 00} {07 08 00}Ma ei
mäleta isegi lille nime!
